title: criteria.json
description: Acceptance criteria as written by `selvedge criteria from-pr|from-md|from-text`. Validated by selvedge/lib/criteria.mjs, whose accepted key sets selvedge/tests/test-criteria.sh asserts equal to the property names here. Each id is c- + the first 12 hex of sha256(text); text is normalized (list and checkbox markers and surrounding whitespace stripped, inner whitespace collapsed).

source.description: A label given with --source, else null (provenance is printed on stderr, so the same criteria from any input give the same bytes).
